x: Heywood scored a runaway victory from Barrett of Ealing with Eldon taking third place inside Stan Cox's record of 54.19. Dave Baulch finished 4th, 9 secs outside the previous record.
Baulch especially was in fine fettle to finish 11th behind such names as Firth, Caulder, Barrett, Towl, Maynard, Clark and Driver, all of whom are in international class in one sphere or another.
